title: Wristwatch with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wrist straps -->
  <rect x="40" y="2" width="20" height="24" rx="6" fill="#4a3b8c"/>
  <rect x="40" y="74" width="20" height="24" rx="6" fill="#4a3b8c"/>
  <!-- strap holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="2.5" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="2.5" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="2.5" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="90" r="2.5" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <!-- strap buckle top -->
  <rect x="38" y="20" width="24" height="7" rx="3" fill="#b8a9ff"/>
  <rect x="44" y="20" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#4a3b8c"/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="28" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="25" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="22" fill="#2a1a4a"/>
  <!-- face glow ring -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- bezel markers -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="2" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="68" r="2" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="2" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="50" r="2" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x="76" y="46" width="7" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <rect x="78" y="47.5" width="5" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="46" r="4.5" fill="#66e0ff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="46" r="4.5" fill="#66e0ff"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="44.5" r="1.8" fill="#2a1a4a"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="44.5" r="1.8" fill="#2a1a4a"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 55 Q50 63 57 55" fill="none" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little hands as eyebrows -->
  <line x1="40" y1="38" x2="46" y2="37" stroke="#ffcf3f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="38" x2="54" y2="37" stroke="#ffcf3f" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
